messages:
andrew: Quick proposal — trial combining ARB + Platform-Standards into a single 30m weekly sync (Weds). Goal: faster triage + fewer duplicate reviews. Looking for volunteers to facilitate the next 6 weeks and to try a tight agenda. Proposed agenda below, want to run 4–6 times and iterate. Thoughts?

andrew: ```
Agenda (30m)
- 5m quick wins / ops notes
- 10m RFC/design deep dive (pre-read required)
- 10m triage (blocked PRs, infra incidents, rollout risks)
- 5m actions + owners + followups
Pre-read: add a 1-pager to the RFC doc and tag @arb by Mon EOD
```

maria: Sounds sensible. One ask: strict timeboxing — use a parking-lot note for overflow items. I can volunteer to facilitate week 1 if that's helpful.

oliver: I can take week 2 and week 4. Also +1 for a facilitator pair per week so handoffs are smoother.

jen: Small conflict — I have an infra sync at 10:00. Can we shift to 10:15–10:45 instead? Otherwise :thumbsup:

andrew: Good catch, jen. 10:15–10:45 works for me. Anyone else blocked by that? If not I'll update the invite.

sarah: Fine for me most weeks. Quick note re: RFC reviews — please include 1–2 golden checks (perf targets / safety gates) in the pre-read so reviewers can scope. Also add a status badge in the header (Ready / Needs work).

maria: Will add a template snippet to the docs repo tomorrow with the badge + a 3-line pre-read checklist.

andrew: Volunteers so far: maria (wk1), oliver (wk2+4). Need wk3, wk5, wk6. Prefer pairing for handoffs — any takers?

arb-bot: Calendar invite created: "ARB + Platform Standards (trial)" Wed 10:15–10:45 weekly x6 — owner: andrew. Link: https://calendar.example/evt/abc123. Reminder: RSVP and attach pre-read by Mon EOD.

jen: I can take week 3, and I can cover week 5 if still needed.

oliver: Happy to pair with jen for week 5.

andrew: Awesome — thanks. I'll update the rotation doc and add a one-line facilitator checklist: pre-read uploaded, timekeeper assigned, parking-lot noted, action owner created.

andrew: Rotation doc: https://go.redwood/arb-rotation — please add yourself for your week and paste the pre-read link.

sarah: One more ops ask: can we enable an automated "start on time" join link that opens 2m early? That'll help strict start times. @eng-infra can we enable that?

maria: I'll ping eng-infra and request the auto-join buffer + a short recording toggle for notes.

andrew: Great — plan: start next Wed, trial for 6 runs, sync back after run 4 with lightweight survey. If anyone wants off the rotation after 2 runs, annotate in the doc. Thanks all.
